create table collections (
        id bigint not null auto_increment,
        name varchar(255) not null,
        translation varchar(255),
        primary key (id)
    ) engine=InnoDB

create table topic_attribute_groups (
        id bigint not null auto_increment,
        multiple bit not null,
        name varchar(255) not null,
        position smallint not null,
        topic_id bigint not null,
        primary key (id)
    ) engine=InnoDB

create table topic_attributes (
        id bigint not null auto_increment,
        data_type varchar(50) not null,
        name varchar(255) not null,
        position smallint not null,
        required bit not null,
        group_id bigint not null,
        primary key (id)
    ) engine=InnoDB

create table topic_item_attribute_groups (
        id bigint not null auto_increment,
        position smallint not null,
        group_definition_id bigint not null,
        topic_item_id bigint not null,
        primary key (id)
    ) engine=InnoDB

create table topic_item_attribute_values (
        id bigint not null auto_increment,
        value TEXT not null,
        topic_attribute_id bigint not null,
        group_instance_id bigint not null,
        primary key (id)
    ) engine=InnoDB

create table topic_items (
        id bigint not null auto_increment,
        topic_id bigint not null,
        primary key (id)
    ) engine=InnoDB

create table topics (
        id bigint not null auto_increment,
        description TEXT,
        description_translation TEXT,
        name varchar(255) not null,
        translation varchar(255),
        collection_id bigint not null,
        parent_id bigint,
        primary key (id)
    ) engine=InnoDB
